pairs: The God of gods, the Lord has spoken,
et vocavit terram a solis ortu usque ad occasum.
and he has called the earth, from the rising of the sun even to its setting,
from Zion, the brilliance of his beauty.
Our God also will not keep silence.
A fire will flare up in his sight,
et in circuitu ejus tempestas valida.
and a mighty tempest will surround him.
He will call to heaven from above,
Gather his holy ones to him,
qui ordinant testamentum ejus super sacrificia.
you who order his covenant above sacrifices.
And the heavens will announce his justice.
my people, and I will speak.
Israel, and I will testify for you.
Non in sacrificiis tuis arguam te;
I will not reprove you for your sacrifices.
holocausta autem tua in conspectu meo sunt semper.
Moreover, your holocausts are ever in my sight.
Non accipiam de domo tua vitulos,
I will not accept calves from your house,
quoniam meæ sunt omnes feræ silvarum,
For all the wild beasts of the forest are mine:
I know all the flying things of the air,
and the beauty of the field is with me.
for the whole world is mine,
Shall I gnaw on the flesh of bulls?
Or would I drink the blood of goats?
Offer to God the sacrifice of praise,
and pay your vows to the Most High.
Et invoca me in die tribulationis:
And call upon me in the day of tribulation.
But to the sinner, God has said:
Why do you discourse on my justices,
et assumis testamentum meum per os tuum?
and take up my covenant through your mouth?
and you have cast my sermons behind you.
et cum adulteris portionem tuam ponebas.
and you have placed your portion with adulterers.
Your mouth has abounded with malice,
and your tongue has concocted deceits.
Sitting, you spoke against your brother,
et adversus filium matris tuæ ponebas scandalum.
and you set up a scandal against your mother’s son.
Existimasti inique quod ero tui similis:
You thought, unjustly, that I ought to be like you.
arguam te, et statuam contra faciem tuam.
But I will reprove you, and I will set myself against your face.
you who forget God; lest at any time,
he might quickly take you away,
and there would be no one to rescue you.
The sacrifice of praise will honor me.
et illic iter quo ostendam illi salutare Dei.
And in that place is the journey by which I will reveal to him the salvation of God.
